tools.name: get_run
tools.description:
Get full details of a simulation run including timing and results.

Returns the complete run record: status, progress, timing (start/end

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description:
Cancel an in-flight simulation run.

Works on runs in built, queued, or computing status. Cleans up
compute resources (terminates EC2 instance, Celery task, or Batch job).

Returns 409 if the run is already in a terminal state
(complete, cancelled, or error).

tools.name: retry_run
tools.description:
Retry a failed simulation run.

Resets an errored run back to 'created' status and triggers a new
package build. The same run ID is reused. Only valid when
status is 'error'. Returns 409 for any other state.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description:
List all simulation runs across all scenarios in a project.

Returns a paginated list of runs. Optionally filter by status
to find active, completed, or failed runs. Each row's presigned
`s3_*_url` download links are elided (6-hour capabilities).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_scenario, get_run, presign_terrain_upload, create_time_series, build_scenario · Private data: get_project, get_scenario, start_simulation, get_run, create_project, presign_terrain_upload, finalize_terrain_upload, get_terrain, create_time_series, attach_input_layer, list_inputs, create_scenario, build_scenario · Public sink: presign_terrain_upload, finalize_terrain_upload, get_terrain, attach_input_layer, build_scenario · Destructive: get_scenario, start_simulation, get_run_status, get_run, cancel_run, retry_run, create_project, presign_terrain_upload, attach_input_layer, create_scenario, build_scenario.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_scenario, get_run, presign_terrain_upload, create_time_series, build_scenario · Private data: get_project, get_scenario, start_simulation, get_run, create_project, presign_terrain_upload, finalize_terrain_upload, get_terrain, create_time_series, attach_input_layer, list_inputs, create_scenario, build_scenario · Public sink: presign_terrain_upload, finalize_terrain_upload, get_terrain, attach_input_layer, build_scenario · Destructive: get_scenario, start_simulation, get_run_status, get_run, cancel_run, retry_run, create_project, presign_terrain_upload, attach_input_layer, create_scenario, build_scenario

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
